blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Proverbs, as repositories of traditional wisdom, have informed human reasoning for millennia. Yet the collective prescriptions they encode have remained largely unquantified. We introduce a computational framework to analyze nearly 50,000 English-language proverbs. Using large language models, validated against human judgments, we map the topical landscape of proverbs, assess their prescriptive power, and quantify their recommendations on key dimensions of human judgment and behavior. We find that most proverbs are prescriptive, offering guidance in domains under individual control, such as preparation and prudent action, whereas proverbs about uncontrollable circumstances, such as fate and mortality, tend to describe rather than prescribe. When prescriptive proverbs take a consistent stance, they favor caution over risk, long-term over short-term outcomes, honesty over deception, and kindness over malice, and show a moderate tendency toward suspicion over trust. On dimensions involving genuine trade-offs, especially autonomy versus compliance, proverbs provide contradicting advice rather than a single recommendation. This analysis provides a quantitative map of the collective prescriptions in a culture's proverbial wisdom, revealing a core of prudent, honest, and forward-looking guidance alongside varied advice where circumstances dictate the best course of action.
blocks.zh: Proverbs作为传统智慧的宝库,为人类的推理提供了上千年的信息. 然而,它们所编码的集体处方基本上仍未确定。 我们引入了一个计算框架,分析近5万个英语谚语。 运用大型语言模型,对照人类判断来验证,我们绘制出谚语的时事地貌,评估其指令性能,并量化其对人类判断和行为的关键层面的建议. 我们发现,大多数谚语都是规范性的,为个人控制的领域提供指导,如准备和审慎行动,而关于命运和死亡等不可控制情况的谚语则倾向于描述而不是规定。 当规范性谚语采取一贯立场时,它们倾向于谨慎而不是风险、长期而不是短期结果、诚实而不是欺骗、善意而不是恶意,并表现出怀疑而不是信任的温和倾向。 关于涉及真正取舍的方面,特别是自治与遵守,谚语提供了相互矛盾的建议,而不是单一的建议。 这一分析提供了一种文化的通俗智慧中集体处方的量化图,揭示出一套审慎、诚实和前瞻性的核心指导,以及各种建议,如果情况决定了最佳行动方针。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: “The wisdom of proverbs has guided people in their social interactions for thousands of years throughout the world” ( Mieder, 2004 , p. xi) . The time-honored lineage, however, does not mean that they are on their way to extinction in a modern and complex world. “Another day, another dollar” or “Garbage in, garbage out” from the world of business and computers are of more recent vintage. According to Mieder 2004 , proverbs are “indeed alive and well, and as sapient nuggets, they continue to play a significant role in the modern age” ( Mieder, 2004 , p. xi) . Proverbs have indeed been extensively investigated from different disciplinary angles such as semiotics, linguistics, cognitive science, literature, media studies and their importance has even given rise to a field of proverb studies, called paremiology (see Hrisztova-Gotthardt and Aleksa Varga, 2015 ) . It is devoted to collecting and classifying proverbs, and examine the form, structure, style, content, function, meaning, and value of proverbs.
blocks.zh: “全世界几千年来,谚语的智慧指导人们的社会互动”(Mieder,2004年,第11页)。 然而,时间荣誉的血统并不意味着他们即将在一个现代和复杂的世界中灭绝。 商业界和计算机界的“又一天又一美元”或“垃圾桶”是最近流行的。 据Mieder 2004所言,谚语“生动活泼,作为精美的花饰,它们在现代继续发挥重要作用”(Mieder,2004年,第11页)。 Proverbs确实从不同的学科角度进行了广泛的调查,如半音学,语言学,认知科学,文学,媒体研究,以及它们的重要性甚至产生了一个谚语研究领域,称为paremiology(见Hrisztova-Gotthardt和Aleksa Varga,2015). 它致力于收集和分类谚语,并审查谚语的形式、结构、风格、内容、功能、含义和价值。

blocks.en: Proverbs’ "economised form helps the speaker to remember and recognise them easily. … [they] allow their users to comment on, standardise and evaluate new situations with the help of known social clichés" ( Lewandowska and Antos, 2014 , p. 182) . Proverbs serve myriad functions, including recommending an action, reconstructing experiences, explaining and reasoning about the past, offering instructions and warnings for the future, as well as encouraging and amusing others ( Lauhakangas, 2007 ) . As diverse as their functions are the subjects in which proverbs are invoked for guidance and sense-making, including practical knowledge of nature, faith and existence, sense of proportion, morality, social interaction, communication, agreements and norms, sense of duty, coping and learning, and sense of time (Norrik, 2014). Employed and likely created by individual speakers for communicative purposes ( Mieder, 2014 ) , their use and success require the acceptance by the people at large ( Firth, 1926 ) . Therefore, they also embody judgments and expressions of traditional and contemporary views and beliefs representative of a conscience linguistique collective (‘collective consciousness’) ( Anscombre, 1994 , p. 100) . By extension, proverbs provide a window on collective prescriptions.
blocks.zh: Proverbs的"economized form"帮助演讲者轻松地回忆并认出他们. [他们]允许用户在已知的社会陈词滥调的帮助下评论,标准化和评价新的情况"(Lewandowska and Antos, 2014, 第182页. 动词服务于多种功能,包括建议行动、重建经验、解释和推理过去、为未来提供指示和警告,以及鼓励和取笑他人(Lahakangas,2007年)。 其职能多种多样,在其中引用谚语进行指导和感知,包括自然、信仰和存在的实用知识、比例感、道德、社会互动、交流、协议和规范、责任感、应对和学习以及时间感(Norrik,2014年)。 使用或可能由个别发言者为交流目的创造(Mieder,2014年),其使用和成功需要广大民众的接受(Firth,1926年)。 因此,它们还体现了传统和当代观点和信仰的判断和表达,这些观点和信仰代表着一种良知的语言集体( " 集体意识 " ) (Anscombre, 1994, 第100页). 因此,谚语为集体处方提供了一个窗口。

blocks.en: It is this potential of proverbs that we study here. To open a window onto the collective consciousness expressed through proverbs, we introduce an analytical-computational framework for characterizing and quantifying their content (see Figure 1 ). We address three research questions. First, using a sample of 49,528 English-language proverbs and large language models, we classify the topics addressed by each proverb based on both its wording and a description of its gist. This analysis identifies the situations represented in proverbs and their relative prevalence. Second, we examine the extent to which proverbs prescribe rather than describe how individuals should act or decide. This distinction parallels prominent accounts of social norms that differentiate social regularities (what people do”) from normative guidance (what people ought to do”) ( Cialdini et al., 1990 ; Bicchieri, 2005 ) . Third, we analyze the direction of these prescriptions across nine fundamental dimensions of human judgment and behavior. Three are central to economic research because they "affect such a broad range of economic decisions …. and [afford] the opportunity to better explain economic behavior" ( Falk et al., 2023 , p. 1935) : risk preference (i.e., recommendation of taking risks or exercising caution), intertemporal preference (i.e., recommendation of actions favoring short-term or long-term consequences) and social preference (i.e., recommendation of own-interest or other-regarding behaviors). The remaining dimensions are compliance vs. autonomy (e.g., Taylor and Patterson, 2010 ; Gruen, 1976 ) , cooperation vs. competition (e.g., Gächter et al., 2010 ) , equality vs. hierarchy (e.g., Hofstede, 1984 ; Rokeach, 1967 ) , honesty vs. deception (e.g., Levine, 2014 ) , kindness vs. malice (e.g., Baron-Cohen, 2011 ) , and trust vs. suspicion (e.g., Inglehart, 2006 ) . For each dimension, we assess which pole is favored by prescriptive proverbs.
blocks.zh: 我们在这里研究的正是这种谚语的潜力。 为了打开通过谚语表达的集体意识的窗口,我们引入了一个分析-计算框架,以定性和量化其内容(见图1)。 我们处理三个研究问题。 首先,我们利用49 528个英文谚语和大语言模型的样本,根据每一谚语的措辞和对语气的描述,对每一句谚语所涉及的专题进行分类。 这一分析确定了谚语中的情况及其相对普遍程度。 第二,我们审查谚语规定的程度,而不是说明个人应如何采取行动或作出决定。 这种区分与区分社会规律(人们做什么)和规范指导(人们应该做什么)的社会规范的突出描述相似(Cialdini等,1990年;Bicchieri,2005年)。 第三,我们分析这些处方在人类判断和行为的九个基本层面的方向. 三是经济研究的核心,因为它们"影响了如此广泛的经济决策.[并]提供了更好地解释经济行为的机会"(Falk等,2023年,第1935页):风险偏好(即建议冒险或谨慎行事),时际偏好(即建议采取有利于短期或长期后果的行动)和社会偏好(即建议自身利益或其他方面的行为). 其余维度有:遵义与自主(如泰勒和帕特森,2010;格鲁恩,1976.),合作与竞争(如盖克特等,2010.),平等与等级(如霍夫斯德,1984.;罗克亚克,1967.),诚实与欺骗(如莱文,2014.),善意与恶意(如巴伦-科亨,2011.),信任与怀疑(如英格莱哈特,2006.). 就每个方面而言,我们评估的是规范谚语所偏爱的哪一柱子。

blocks.en: Of the seven collection of proverbs used here, five focus on American or British proverbs, whereas the other two are multicultural or global in scope. We analyze the collections in aggregate and also report results separately for each collection, allowing us to assess the extent to which the wisdom expressed in proverbs is shared across cultural traditions rather than specific to English-speaking contexts, even though this is not our focus here.
blocks.zh: 在此处使用的7个谚语集中,有5个侧重于美国或英国谚语,而其他2个则具有多元文化或全球范围. 我们综合分析汇编,并分别报告每项汇编的结果,使我们能够评估谚语中表达的智慧在多大程度上在文化传统之间分享,而不是专门针对英语背景,尽管这不是我们这里的重点。

blocks.en: 2 Results
blocks.zh: 2 结果

blocks.en: 2.1 Using LLMs to evaluate the meaning of proverbs
blocks.zh: 2.1 利用法学硕士评估谚语的含义

blocks.en: To map the collective consciousness reflected in proverbs, we first charted the semantic landscape of our corpus using LLMs. Where previous studies were limited to the manual examination of small samples, our computational approach permits a systematic analysis of a large corpus of proverbial record.
blocks.zh: 为了描绘出谚语中反映的集体意识,我们首先用LLMs绘制了我们教程的语义图. 以前的研究仅限于手工检查小样本,我们的计算方法允许对大量谚语记录进行系统分析。

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows the topical landscape of proverbs, visualized as a semantic map in which proximity indicates thematic similarity. The most frequent topic is, fittingly, wisdom itself (n = 1,465), suggesting that proverbs often reflect on the very knowledge they are meant to transmit. Several of the most frequent topics concern foresight and careful action, including consequences (n = 1,377), caution (n = 1,354), and prudence (n = 1,127), which foreshadows the prescriptions we identify in the following. Proverbs also frequently address deception (n = 1,167), the social world, as in relationships and friendship, and even existential themes such as mortality. This topical profile shows that proverbs focus on the perennial challenges of judgment and social life.
blocks.zh: 图2显示了谚语的主题地貌,可视化为语义地图,其中相近表示主题相似. 最常见的话题是智慧本身(n = 1 465),说明谚语经常反思它们要传播的知识本身。 几个最常见的专题涉及远见和谨慎行动,包括后果(n=1 377)、谨慎(n=1 354)和谨慎(n=1 127),这些都预示了我们在以下各点中所确定的处方。 Proverbs还经常涉及欺骗(n = 1,167),社会世界,如关系和友谊,甚至死亡等活生生的主题. 这一专题简介表明,谚语侧重于判断和社会生活的长期挑战。

blocks.en: To validate our computational approach, we compared the model’s ratings of proverbs against the judgments of human raters. At the level of individual proverbs, the model’s ratings agreed more strongly with the average human judgment than human raters agreed with each other, and this held for every dimension we assessed. Agreement was higher when raters were shown the model-generated explanation of a proverb’s gist, but the pattern of results was unchanged without it. When ratings were aggregated across proverbs to characterize the nine key dimensions, the correspondence between model and human judgments was high (r = .74). These results indicate that the model captures the human understanding of proverbs, supporting its use for analyzing proverb content at a scale unattainable through manual coding.
blocks.zh: 为了验证我们的计算方法,我们比较了模型对谚语的评分和人类评分者的判断。 在个别谚语方面,模型的评级更强烈地认同人类的平均判断,而不是人类的评分者彼此同意,这对我们所评估的每个层面都很重要。 当对一个谚语的要旨给出模型生成的解释时,一致程度更高,但结果模式没有变化。 当通过各种谚语汇总评级来描述九个关键层面时,模型与人类判断之间的对应度很高(r=.74)。 这些结果表明,该模型捕捉了人类对谚语的理解,支持它通过人工编码在无法达到的尺度上分析谚语内容.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Topical landscape of proverbs and validation of model ratings. (A) Two-dimensional projection of the semantic space of proverb topics. Each circle represents a topic tag, and topics appearing closer together are semantically similar. Labels mark the most frequent topics, with font size proportional to topic frequency and colors indicating clusters of similar topics. (B) Alignment of proverb ratings, measured as Pearson correlations, for each rated dimension and for the aggregate analysis across the nine dimensions of judgment and behavior. Green points show the alignment between the average human rating and the model’s ratings, and purple points show the alignment among human raters. Circles and triangles show ratings obtained with and without the model-generated gist explanation, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图2:谚语主题地貌与示范收视率的验证. (A) 二维投影 谚语主题的语义空间. 每个圆形代表一个主题标记,同时出现更相近的话题在本质上相似. 标签标记了最常见的主题,字体大小与主题频率和颜色成正比,表示类似主题的集群. (B) 以皮尔逊关系衡量的谚语评分对准每个被评分的维度,并对判断和行为的九个维度进行综合分析。 绿色分数显示人类平均分数与模型分数的一致,而紫色分数显示人类分数的一致. 圆形和三角形分别显示通过和没有模型生成的Gist解释获得的收视率.

blocks.en: 2.2 Scoring the prescriptivity of proverbs
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 将谚语的先入为主

blocks.en: Proverbs can guide behavior, as in “Measure twice, cut once;” but they can also simply describe the world, as in “Every rose has its thorn.” To quantify these two functions, we prompted an LLM to rate the prescriptive capacity of each proverb, that is, the extent to which it provides guidance on how to act or decide. Figure 3 shows the average prescriptive capacity of proverbs for each topic.
blocks.zh: 动词可以指导行为,如“两次度量,一次切;”但是它们也可以简单地描述世界,如“每一朵玫瑰都有它的刺 ” 。 为了量化这两个功能,我们促使一个LLM来评定每个谚语的规范能力,即它就如何采取行动或作出决定提供指导的程度。 图3显示每个专题的谚语的平均规范能力。

blocks.en: We found that most proverbs prescribe. The LLM rated 67.1% of proverbs as prescriptive, and human raters classified an even larger share as prescriptive (73.8%). Prescription rather than description is thus the rule in the proverbial record.
blocks.zh: 我们发现大多数谚语都这样 LLM将67.1%的谚语评为规范语,而人类的评分将更大的比例归为规范语(73.8%). 因此,说明而不是描述是谚语记录中的规则。

blocks.en: Prescriptive capacity nevertheless varied systematically across topics. Proverbs were most prescriptive in domains of deliberate action, including preparation, strategy, prudence, prevention, caution, and moderation. These are domains in which behavior is under the individual’s control and clear guidance is valuable. In contrast, prescriptive capacity was lowest for topics concerning circumstances that lie largely beyond individual control, such as fate, inevitability, mortality, human nature, and suffering. Proverbs in these domains tend to describe and make sense of the human condition rather than direct behavior. Analyses by collection, shown by the grey vertical lines, revealed no substantial differences in prescriptivity across the seven sources. This pattern suggests a division of labor in proverbial wisdom. Where action is possible, proverbs tend to take on a more prescriptive role, as in “Make hay while the sun shines”; where it is not, they tend to console and explain, as in “What will be, will be”. Even largely descriptive proverbs, however, may carry implicit guidance, because statements about what is often convey implications about what one ought to do ( Bicchieri, 2005 ) .
blocks.zh: 然而,各专题的描述能力却有系统差异。 在准备、战略、谨慎、预防、谨慎和节制等有意行动领域,动词最具规范性。 这些领域的行为在个人的控制之下,明确的指导是有价值的。 与此相反,在涉及基本上超出个人控制范围的情况,如命运、必然性、死亡率、人性以及痛苦等问题上,规范能力最低。 这些领域的正词倾向于描述和理解人的状况,而不是直接的行为. 以灰色纵线显示的通过收集进行的分析显示,7个来源的指令性没有实质性差异。 这种模式在谚语智慧中暗示了劳动分工. 在可能采取行动的地方,谚语往往发挥更规范的作用,如在“使干草趁日出”中;如果不是,谚语则倾向于安慰和解释,如在“什么将会是”中。 然而,即使基本是描述性的谚语,也可能带有隐含的取向,因为关于人们经常表达自己应该做什么的意义(Bicchieri,2005年)。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Average prescriptive capacity of proverbs by topic. Higher values indicate that proverbs within a topic provide more guidance on how to act or decide. Point size is proportional to the number of proverbs in a topic, and colors correspond to the topic clusters shown in Figure 2 . The vertical axis separates clusters for readability and carries no meaning. Grey vertical lines show averages by collections.
blocks.zh: 图3:按主题分列的谚语的平均规范能力。 更高的价值表明,一个专题内的谚语为如何采取行动或作出决定提供了更多的指导。 点大小与一个话题中的谚语数量成正比,而颜色对应的是图2所显示的主题集群. 垂直轴为可读性而分离出集群,没有意义. 灰相垂直行按收藏显示平均值.

blocks.en: 2.3 Evaluating the polarity of proverb prescriptions
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 评价谚语处方的两极性

blocks.en: A fascinating characteristic of proverbs is their ability to advocate opposing behaviors, a quality that has long intrigued scholars ( Breton, 1631 ) . In the domain of risk taking, for instance, we find both “Fortune favors the bold” and “Look before you leap.” Similarly, “Many hands make light work” promotes joint effort, whereas “Too many cooks spoil the broth” warns against it. Despite the prominence of such contradictions, it remains unclear whether they are a general feature of proverbial wisdom or are concentrated on particular dimensions of judgment and behavior. Some dimensions may give rise to competing forms of advice, whereas others may be associated with a clear consensus.
blocks.zh: 谚语的一个引人入胜的特征是它们能够鼓吹对立的行为,这种品质让学者长期感兴趣(Breton, 1631). 例如,在冒险领域,我们发现“财富有利于大胆者”和“跳跃前看 ” 。 同样, “许多手做轻活”促进共同努力,而“太多的厨师捣乱了汤”则警告不要这样做。 尽管这些矛盾十分突出,但目前仍不清楚它们是谚语智慧的一般特征,还是集中在判断和行为的特定方面. 某些方面可能引起相互竞争的咨询形式,而另一些方面则可能与明确的共识有关。

blocks.en: To address this question, we characterized the recommendations of prescriptive proverbs, that is, proverbs rated as providing guidance (“yes” or “strong yes”), on each dimension using two measures, computed separately for LLM and human ratings. Polarity captures the balance of the recommendations, ranging from 0, when all recommendations favor the same pole, to 1, when recommendations are evenly split between the poles. Extremity captures how often proverbs take a stance on a dimension, measured as the proportion of ratings outside the midpoint category.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们用两种衡量标准,分别计算LLM和人类的评级,来描述规范性谚语的建议,即被评为对每个方面提供指导的谚语(“是”或“强烈是”)。 极性捕捉到建议的平衡,从0,当所有建议都支持同一极,到1,当建议均匀地分出各极. 极端地捕捉出谚语在某一维度上采取立场的频率,以中点类别外的收分比例来衡量.

blocks.en: Figure 4 A shows that contradiction is a selective rather than a general feature of proverbial wisdom. LLM and human ratings converge in identifying autonomy versus compliance as a highly contested dimension, with recommendations split markedly between the poles (polarity of about .65 for both). For equality and social interests, in contrast, the LLM perceived substantially more contradiction than human raters, who saw proverbs as speaking with a more unified voice. In contrast, both LLM and human raters consistently viewed the proverbs as prescribing kindness over malice and honesty over deception, with little contradictory proverbs. We return to the direction of these recommendations in the next section.
blocks.zh: 图4 A显示,矛盾是谚语智慧的选择性而非一般特征. LLM与人类的评级趋同,将自主性与合规性确定为一个极具争议的层面,建议在两极之间明显分化(两极的极性约为.65个)。 就平等和社会利益而言,相对而言,LLM认为比人类评价者矛盾得多,他们认为谚语用更统一的声音说话。 相比之下,LLM和人类评分者都一贯认为谚语比恶意和诚实比欺骗更能说明问题,几乎没有自相矛盾的谚语。 我们将在下一节中回到这些建议的方向。

blocks.en: In some dimensions, proverbs are more extreme than in other dimensions. According to both LLM and human ratings, proverbs are more extreme for the classic trade-offs of decision making, namely time, risk, autonomy, and own versus others’ interests, suggesting that a stance on these dimensions is nearly inseparable from prescriptive advice. In contrast, proverbs about honesty and kindness tend to be less extreme. Moreover, polarity was strikingly consistent across collections, as indicated by the vertical grey lines, suggesting that the prescriptions expressed in proverbs share common features across cultural traditions.
blocks.zh: 在某些维度上,谚语比其他维度更极端. 根据LLM和人类的评级,对于决策的经典取舍,即时间、风险、自主以及自身与他人的利益,谚语更为极端,这表明在这些方面的立场与指令性建议几乎密不可分。 相形之下,关于诚实和善意的谚语往往不那么极端. 此外,正如纵向灰色线所显示的,各集的两极性明显一致,这表明谚语中表述的处方在各种文化传统中具有共同的特征。

blocks.en: Overall, this pattern suggests that proverbial wisdom speaks with one voice on moral virtues, such as honesty and kindness, but preserves competing counsel where interests and situations genuinely conflict, most clearly on the tension between autonomy and compliance. Rather than a set of dogmatic rules, proverbs seem to be a repertoire of context-dependent wisdom, offering firm norms where consensus exists and alternative strategies where it does not.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这种模式表明,一句谚语的智慧用一个声音讲道德德行,如诚实和善意,但在利益和局势真正相冲突的地方却保留了相互竞争的顾问,最明显的是自治与遵守之间的紧张关系。 谚语似乎不是一套教条规则,而是一套依赖背景的智慧,在存在共识的地方提供坚定的规范,在没有共识的地方提供替代战略。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Recommendations of prescriptive proverbs (rated “yes” or “strong yes” on prescriptivity) on the nine dimensions of human judgment and behavior. (A) Extremity and polarity of proverb recommendations, based on human ratings (circles) and LLM ratings (squares). Extremity is the proportion of prescriptive proverbs rated outside the midpoint category. Polarity captures the balance of recommendations, ranging from 0, when all recommendations favor the same pole, to 1, when recommendations are evenly split between the poles. Dashed lines connect the two ratings of the same dimension. (B) Average recommendations by dimension. Each panel shows one dimension, with arrows indicating the poles. Small points show the average rating of proverbs within a topic, and labels mark the topics leaning most strongly toward either pole. Large points show the overall average of proverb ratings by human raters (circles) and by the LLM (squares). The vertical line marks indifference between the two poles; averages to its left indicate a leaning toward the left pole and averages to its right a leaning toward the right pole. Grey vertical lines show averages by collections.
blocks.zh: 图4:关于人类判断和行为九个方面的规定性谚语(在规定性上被评为“是”或“强烈”)的建议。 (A) 谚语建议的极端和极性,基于人类的评级(circles)和LLM评级(quares). 极端是被评为中点类别外的规范谚语的比例. 极性捕捉到建议的平衡,从0,当所有建议都支持同一极,到1,当建议均匀地被分出来. 虚线连接了同维度的两个收视率. (B) 按方面分列的平均建议。 每个面板显示一个维,并有箭头指示杆. 小分点显示一个话题中谚语的平均评分,标签标出最倾向于任意一极的主题. 大分显示被人评分(circles)和LLM(平分)评分的谚语总平均分. 垂直线标志着两根柱子之间的冷漠;其左侧平均线指向左柱子倾斜,而右侧平均线指向右柱子倾斜. 灰相垂直行按收藏显示平均值.

blocks.en: 2.4 Charting collective prescriptions
blocks.zh: 2.4 制定集体处方

blocks.en: Having established that most proverbs prescribe, we can now ask what they prescribe. Figure 4 B maps the average recommendation on each of the nine dimensions of judgment and behavior among prescriptive proverbs, as rated by the LLM and by human judges. We observe broadly similar patterns across the seven proverb collections (as indicated by the vertical gray lines), indicating that the aggregate results are not attributable to a single collection.
blocks.zh: 在确定了大多数谚语的规定之后,我们现在可以问它们的规定是什么。 图 页:1 B描绘了由LLM和人类法官评分的规范谚语对判断和行为九个层面中的每一个层面的平均建议。 我们观察到7个谚语集的大致相似的规律(如垂直灰色线所示),表明总结果不归于一个集.

blocks.en: Proverbial wisdom takes a clear side on four dimensions, and the model and human raters agree on all of them. Proverbs endorse caution over risk taking, as in “Look before you leap,” long-term over short-term consequences, as in “Don’t put all your eggs in one basket,” honesty over deception, as in “Honesty is the best policy,” and kindness over malice, as in “Good to forgive, best to forget.” The endorsement of long-term thinking showed the clearest and most consistent advice. These prescriptions closely track empirical findings on human preferences, including widespread risk aversion ( Bernoulli, 1738 ; Falk et al., 2023 ) , the economic benefits associated with long-term orientation ( Falk et al., 2023 ; Becker and Mulligan, 1997 ; Lawrance, 1991 ) , and the observation that people are often truthful and generous even at a cost to themselves ( Gneezy, 2005 ; Abeler et al., 2019 ; Fehr and Fischbacher, 2003 ) . Proverbs may help sustain these tendencies by transmitting the corresponding norms across generations and cultural contexts.
blocks.zh: 普罗维生智慧在四个维度上采取明确的一面,模型和人评分者都同意. 论者赞同谨慎对待风险,如“先看再跳 ” 的长期短期后果,如“不要把鸡蛋放在一个篮子里 ” , “ 诚实战胜欺骗 ” , 如“热情是最好的政策 ” , “ 善意战胜恶意 ” , 如“好原谅,最好忘记 ” 。 对长期思维的认可显示了最明确和最一致的建议。 这些处方密切跟踪关于人类偏好的经验结论,包括普遍的规避风险(Bernoulli,1738;Falk等,2023;与长期取向有关的经济利益(Falk等,2023;Becker和Mulligan,1997;Larrance,1991;)),以及人们往往诚实而慷慨,即使自己付出了代价的意见(Gneezy,2005;Abeler等,2019;Fehr和Fischbacher,2003)。 动词可以通过代际和文化背景传播相应的规范来帮助维持这些趋势.

blocks.en: A clear and surprising pattern also emerged for trust. Proverbs lean toward suspicion rather than trust, as in “Trust, but verify.” This tendency was evident across collections, suggesting that proverbial traditions from different cultural sources share a concern with the risks of misplaced trust. This may reflect a basic asymmetry: the benefits of trust are often small and gradual, whereas its failures can be immediate and costly. Trust enables cooperation and exchange, but it also leaves people vulnerable to exploitation ( Berg et al., 1995 ; Knack and Keefer, 1997 ; Putnam, 1993 ) . Proverbial wisdom appears to place greater weight on avoiding exploitation. 1 1 1 This pattern was not observed in Figure 4A, where the polarity measure reflects only the direction of the prescription and does not incorporate its strength.
blocks.zh: 信任也出现了一个明确而出人意料的模式。 动词倾向于怀疑而不是信任,如“信任,但核实”。 这一趋势在收藏中很明显,这表明来自不同文化来源的谚语传统都对错误信任的风险感到关切。 这可能反映出一种基本的不对称性:信任的好处往往很小,是渐进的,而信任的失败可能是立即的和昂贵的。 信任有助于合作和交流,但也使人们容易受到剥削(Berg等人,1995年;Knack和Keefer,1997年;Putnam,1993年)。 Proverbial智慧似乎更加重视避免剥削。 1个 1 图4A没有观察到这种模式,其中极性度量只反映处方方向,不包含其强度.

blocks.en: The remaining dimensions show little overall consensus for one side or the other. Recommendations concerning cooperation versus competition, own versus others’ interests, autonomy versus compliance, and equality versus hierarchy average close to indifference. This does not reflect an absence of advice. On the contrary, these are the dimensions that generated highly contradictory prescriptions. Their neutral averages arise because opposing messages coexist within the same dimension and largely offset one another. This coexistence of opposing prescriptions was observed across collections, indicating that it is not merely an artifact of combining culturally distinct sources. Rather, proverbial traditions appear to preserve competing counsel where the best course of action depends on circumstances.
blocks.zh: 其余层面对一方或另一方没有表现出总体共识。 关于合作与竞争、自身与他人利益、自主与遵守、平等与等级等几乎无动于衷的建议。 这并不反映缺乏咨询意见。 相反,这些方面产生了高度自相矛盾的处方。 产生它们的中性平均值,是因为相互对立的信息在同一层面共存,而且在很大程度上相互抵消。 在各种收藏中都观察到这种相互对立的处方并存的现象,这表明它不仅仅是将文化上不同的来源结合起来的一件艺术品。 相反,谚语传统似乎保留了相互竞争的律师,因为最佳行动方针取决于具体情况。

blocks.en: These contested dimensions are also where model and human ratings diverge most. Human raters perceived proverbs as leaning toward hierarchy and toward own-interest, whereas the model rated them as neutral or mildly favoring others’ interests, and the model perceived a leaning toward autonomy that human raters did not perceive. Given the strong overall agreement between model and human ratings, these divergences are the exception rather than the rule, but they suggest caution in interpreting the precise position of proverbs on the contested dimensions.
blocks.zh: 这些有争议的方面也是模型和人类评级差异最大的方面。 人类评分者认为谚语倾向于等级和自身利益,而模型则将其评为中性或温和地有利于他人利益,模型则认为倾向于人类评分者不认为的自主。 鉴于模型与人类评级之间的普遍强烈一致,这些差异是例外而不是规则,但它们建议在解释谚语在有争议的方面的确切立场时要谨慎。

blocks.en: Taken together, the proverbs reveal a coherent set of priorities that is broadly consistent across collections. They favor caution over risk, patience over immediacy, honesty over deception, and kindness over malice. At the same time, they are skeptical of misplaced trust. On questions of social organization, however, they are less decisive. Cooperation and competition, autonomy and compliance, equality and hierarchy all attract competing advice.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,谚语揭示出一套一致的优先事项,这些优先事项在各种文献中大体一致。 他们主张谨慎,不要冒险,不要耐心,不要急躁,不要诚实,不要欺骗,不要善意,不要恶意。 同时,他们怀疑错误的信任。 但是,在社会组织问题上,它们不那么具有决定性。 合作与竞争、自主与遵守、平等和等级均吸引了相互竞争的建议。

blocks.en: 3 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3 讨论情况

blocks.en: This work makes a significant contribution by moving the study of proverbs from qualitative interpretation to quantitative cultural analytics. The use of LLMs allows us to analyze cultural products at an unprecedented scale ( Hussain et al., 2024 ; Binz et al., 2025 ) , revealing systematic patterns in the repository of proverbial wisdom. Our principal insight is that this wisdom is not random. Where proverbs take a consistent side, they advise caution, long-term thinking, honesty, and kindness, tempered by some skepticism of misplaced trust. This aggregate advice paints a portrait of a cultural toolkit designed to foster prudent behavior and reliable social relations. The recurrence of these patterns across collections is suggestive of cross-cultural consistency, although the predominantly American and British source base warrants caution. As cultural products, proverbs store and transmit this wisdom, reflecting the values that have emerged as adaptive over generations ( Weber et al., 1998 ) .
blocks.zh: 通过将谚语研究从定性解释转向定量文化分析,这项工作做出了重大贡献. 使用LLMs使我们能够以前所未有的规模分析文化产品(Hussain等,2024年;Binz等,2025年),揭示出谚语智慧库中的系统模式。 我们的主要见解是,这种智慧不是随机的。 如果谚语持一贯的一面,它们建议谨慎、长期思考、诚实和善意,并被一些对错误信任的怀疑所缓和。 这份汇总建议描绘出一个文化工具包的肖像,旨在培养谨慎的行为和可靠的社会关系. 尽管以美国和英国为主的来源基础值得谨慎,但各种收藏中这些模式的再现表明跨文化的一致性。 作为文化产品,谚语储存并传播这种智慧,反映了代代相传的适应价值(Weber等,1998年)。

blocks.en: Equally revealing is where proverbial wisdom does not speak with one voice. On dimensions involving genuine and difficult trade-offs, most clearly the tension between autonomy and compliance, proverbs offer competing advice, and their recommendations balance each other out in the aggregate. Rather than a set of dogmatic rules, the proverbial record thus resembles a repertoire of context-dependent guides, offering firm norms where consensus exists and alternative strategies where the best course of action depends on circumstances. This may explain why the contradictions among proverbs, long noted by scholars ( Yankah, 1984 ) , coexist with their authority as vehicles of advice.
blocks.zh: 同样说明问题之处是,众所周知的智慧并不以一个声音说话。 关于真正和困难的取舍问题,最明显的是自主与遵守之间的紧张关系,谚语提供了相互竞争的建议,其建议在总体上是相互平衡的。 因此,比起一套教条规则,谚语记录类似于一系列依赖背景的指南,在有共识的地方提供坚定的准则,在最佳行动方针取决于具体情况的情况下提供其他战略。 这或许可以解释为什么学者们长期注意到的谚语之间的矛盾(Yankah,1984年)与他们作为咨询工具的权威共存。

blocks.en: This study provides the groundwork for future research. An obvious extension is cross-cultural comparison. Such work could test whether documented differences in risk attitudes and social preferences across countries ( Falk et al., 2023 ) are mirrored in the prescriptions encoded in proverbial traditions, a hypothesis previously explored only with small-scale studies ( Weber et al., 1998 ) . Another testable hypothesis emerged in our analysis. It appears as if that proverbs from different cultural sources offer clear, consistent and culture-general guidance in domains where the costs and benefits are, ceteris paribus, relatively context-independent and established such as when they highlight the value of patience over immediacy (e.g., compound effects, information accumulation over time, cost of mistakes, better cooperation). In contrast, they preserve multiple, even opposite and, perhaps, culture-specific perspectives where the best course of action depends on the circumstances (e.g., autonomy vs. compliance). In studying these and other questions of culture-specificity or generality, the main challenge is attributing available and published proverbial corpora to cultures unambiguously–commonly corpora represent collections across cultures.
blocks.zh: 这项研究为今后的研究奠定了基础。 一个明显的延伸是跨文化比较。 这项工作可以检验各国(Falk等,2023年)在风险态度和社会偏好方面的记录差异是否反映在谚语传统中编码的处方中,这一假设以前只是通过小规模研究加以探讨的(Weber等,1998年)。 在我们的分析中出现了另一个可验证的假设。 不同的文化来源的谚语似乎在成本和效益相对独立的领域提供了明确、一致和以文化为主的指导,如强调耐心对即时性的价值(如复合效应、信息累积、错误的代价、更好的合作)。 相反,它们保留了多种甚至相反的、也许与文化有关的观点,即最佳行动方针取决于具体情况(例如自主与遵守)。 在研究这些和其他文化特异性或通俗性问题时,主要的挑战在于将现有和出版的谚语集中到各种文化中去,这些文化通常代表各种文化的收藏。

blocks.en: Another future extension is to compare our topic taxonomy could with existing, manually crafted paremiological classifications to bridge computational and traditional humanities scholarship. The value of our framework lies in its capacity to scale up such analyses, transforming proverbs into a quantitative resource for tracking cultural values over time and across societies.
blocks.zh: 未来的另一个延伸是比较我们的专题分类学可以与现有的手工制作的平面分类来沟通计算学和传统人文学奖学金。 我们的框架的价值在于它有能力扩大这种分析,把谚语变成追踪文化价值的量化资源,并随着时间推移和跨社会。

blocks.en: 3.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: 3.1 限制

blocks.en: Our analysis has limitations. Many proverbs are time-honored artifacts, reflecting the views of a past era. Proverbs like “Don’t put the cart before the horse” highlight the historical context in which they emerged. This historical orientation is inherent to the study of proverbial tradition itself. For a saying to become established as a proverb, it must be retained across generations. As a result, proverb collections are particularly well suited to capturing culturally durable views, but are less likely to reflect ideas that have only recently emerged. Although new proverbs continually enter the lexicon to reflect modern life (“The internet never forgets”), our corpus is naturally biased toward views that have stood the test of time. Future work could incorporate sources of modern proverbs to capture the views of the current information age that may become proverbial in the future, such as “Data is the new oil,” which equates data with a critical economic resource. Together, these sources could help trace both the persistence of collective prescriptions and their evolution over time.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析是有局限性的。 许多谚语是被时间尊崇的文物,反映了过去时代的观点. “不要把推车放在马前”等动词突出了它们出现的历史背景。 这种历史取向是研究谚语传统本身所固有的. 一句谚语要成为谚语,就必须世代相传。 因此,谚语集特别适合捕捉文化上可持久的观点,但不太可能反映最近才出现的想法. 虽然新的谚语不断被输入词汇表以反映现代生活(“互联网永远不会忘记”), 今后的工作可以包括现代谚语的来源,以了解今后可能成为谚语的当前信息时代的观点,例如“数据是新石油”,它将数据等同于重要的经济资源。 这些来源合在一起,可有助于追踪集体处方的持续存在及其随时间的演变。

blocks.en: Another limitation concerns the type-token distinction. We analyzed each proverb as a unique type, irrespective of its prevalence in natural language (its token frequency). An alternative approach would be to analyze the frequency of each proverb’s occurrence. However, because proverbs are more prevalent in spoken language and relatively rare in written corpora, such an analysis would require enormous volumes of text to yield reliable estimates.
blocks.zh: 另一项限制涉及类型区分。 我们分析每种谚语都是独特的类型,而不论其在自然语言中的流行程度(其象征频率)。 另一种办法是分析每一句谚语的发生频率。 然而,由于谚语在口语中更为普遍,在书面公司中相对罕见,这种分析需要大量文本才能得出可靠的估计.

blocks.en: A further limitation is that our corpus consists predominantly of English-language proverbs, although two of the seven sources comprise worldwide or multicultural collections. The main patterns were consistent across collections, suggesting some convergence across cultural traditions. Nevertheless, because collections do not map neatly onto cultures, research using non-English and culturally defined corpora is needed to establish cross-cultural generalizability. Let us finally highlight that there is still no consensus definition of what makes something a "proverb," as opposed to a proverbial phrase, idiom, maxim, slogan, or aphorism. Wolfgang Mieder—arguably the field’s most prominent contemporary researcher—has spent decades refining definitions, yet the boundaries remain fuzzy. Is "garbage in, garbage out" a proverb? What about internet-era formulations like "pics or it didn’t happen"? To the extent that proverbs and related constructs offer us a window onto collective wisdom, preferences, and cultural priors, we tend to prefer a wider rather than a narrower definition, and, therefore, we did not winnow down the corpora.
blocks.zh: 另一个限制是,我们的书目主要包括英语谚语,虽然七个来源中有两个来源是世界或多文化的书目。 各种收藏的主要模式是一致的,表明各种文化传统之间有些趋同。 尽管如此,由于藏品并没有清晰地映射出文化,所以需要使用非英语和文化定义的"蝎子"进行研究,以建立跨文化通俗性. 最后,让我们强调,对于是什么使某事成为“副词”仍然没有共识的定义,而与之相对的是一句谚语、谚语、口号或口号。 沃尔夫冈·米德(Wolfgang Mieder) — — 可以说是这个领域最出名的当代研究人员 — — 花了几十年的时间来完善定义,但边界仍然模糊不清。 "垃圾倒入垃圾"是不是一句谚语? 网络时代的配方, 只要谚语和相关的构思为我们提供了一个了解集体智慧、喜好和文化前科的窗口,我们往往倾向于更宽泛而不是更狭隘的定义,因此,我们没有打倒公司。

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Identifying Proverbs
blocks.zh: 4.1 辩证词

blocks.en: We aggregated proverbs from seven published collections: A Dictionary of American Proverbs ( Mieder, 1992 ) , The Dictionary of Modern Proverbs ( Doyle et al., 2012 ) , Dictionary of Authentic American Proverbs ( Mieder, 2021 ) , A Dictionary of Proverbs ( Simpson and Speake, 2008 ) , Little Oxford Dictionary of Proverbs ( Knowles, 2016 ) , The Multicultural Dictionary of Proverbs ( Cordry, 2015 ) , and The Routledge Book of World Proverbs ( Stone, 2006 ) . We extracted proverbs from the digitized collections using source-specific extraction rules, retaining main entries as well as variants listed in the collections. All entries were converted to lowercase, stripped of terminal punctuation and residual formatting, and deduplicated. Entries containing parenthetical variant insertions, which some collections use to indicate alternative wordings, were manually expanded into their full variants. This procedure yielded an initial list of 49,528 unique proverbs.
blocks.zh: 我们汇总了7个已出版集的谚语: A Dictionary of American Proverbs (Mieder, 1992),"现代Proverbs"(Doyle等,2012),"真实美国Proverbs"(Mieder,2021),"活字"(Simpson and Speake,2008),"小牛津活字"(Knowles,2016),"活字"(Cordry,2015)和"活字"(The Routledge Book of World Proverbs (Stone,2006)). 我们利用特定来源的提取规则,从数字化的集合中提取出谚语,保留了主要条目和集合中所列的变体。 所有条目被转换为小写,剥去终端标出和剩余格式,并被调出。 含有括号式变体插入的条目,有些集合用来表示替代措辞,被手动扩充为完整的变体. 这一程序初步列出了49,528个独特的谚语。

blocks.en: A Dictionary of American Proverbs defines proverbs as concise statements of apparent truths in common circulation and includes traditional English-language and American-origin proverbs collected by the American Dialect Society between the 1940s and 1970s; it excludes proverbial expressions, comparisons, superstitions, wellerisms, and idioms ( Mieder, 1992 ) . The Dictionary of Modern Proverbs focuses on proverbs originating in English since 1900 and, more broadly, on expressions current in modern usage. It defines “true proverbs” as complete or elliptical sentences that are formulaic but variable and express general observations or propositions, often figuratively; proverbial phrases, wellerisms, and sarcastic interrogatives are excluded ( Doyle et al., 2012 ) . The Dictionary of Authentic American Proverbs provides no explicit definition but includes proverbs coined in North America between the seventeenth and twenty-first centuries ( Mieder, 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 《美国动词词典》将谚语定义为对共同流通的明显真理的简明陈述,并包括美国糖尿病学会在1940至1970年代收集的传统英语和源自美国的谚语;它排除了谚语表达、比较、迷信、井上和平庸(Mieder,1992年)。 "现代口语词典"主要关注自1900年起由英语发音的谚语,更广义地讲,关注现代用法中流传的表达. 它将“真正的谚语”定义为完整或椭圆的句子,这些句子是公式化的但可变的,并表达一般的观察或命题,常常是比喻性的;谚语短语、井然论和讽刺性审讯被排除在外(Doyle等,2012年)。 "美国正文词典"(英語:The Dictionary of American Proverbs)没有给出明确的定义,而包括了17至21世纪在北美铸造的谚语(Mieder,2021.).

blocks.en: A Dictionary of Proverbs defines a proverb as a traditional, concise saying that offers advice or presents a moral, and focuses on expressions used in Britain during the past two centuries, including some circulating throughout the English-speaking world ( Simpson and Speake, 2008 ) . The Little Oxford Dictionary of Proverbs adopts a broader criterion, including proverbs and sayings from biblical, classical, global, and popular-cultural traditions, selected to represent diverse forms of actual usage, especially in advice and admonition ( Knowles, 2016 ) .
blocks.zh: 《Proverbs词典》将谚语定义为一种提供建议或提出道德观点的传统而简洁的说法,并侧重于过去两个世纪中英国使用的表达方式,包括一些在英语世界中流传的表达方式(Simpson and Speake, 2008.). 《牛津小词典》采纳了更广泛的标准,包括圣经、古典、全球和大众文化传统的谚语和谚语,被选为代表各种实际使用形式,特别是在建议和告诫方面(Knowles, 2016年)。

blocks.en: Similarly, The Multicultural Dictionary of Proverbs includes cross-cultural expressions of practical wisdom, as well as maxims understood as explicit or implicit rules of conduct ( Cordry, 2015 ) . Finally, The Routledge Book of World Proverbs includes expressions that most folklorists and paremiologists would recognise as proverbs ( Stone, 2006 ) .
blocks.zh: 同样地,"Proverbs"的"多元文化词典"包括了实用智慧的跨文化表达,以及被理解为明示或隐含的行为规则的格言(Cordry,2015. 终于 《世界动词典》(Routledge Book of World Proverbs)包含了大多数民俗主义者和教友会承认为谚语的表达(Stone,2006年).

blocks.en: Overall, these sources variously emphasize form, tradition, circulation, function, historical or geographical origin, and recognition by experts. We therefore adopt a compiler-based operational criterion: expressions are treated as proverbs when they are classified as such in at least one of these collections, subject to the additional selection criteria described in the main text.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些来源强调形式、传统、流通、功能、历史或地理渊源以及专家的承认。 因此,我们采用一个基于汇编器的操作标准:在其中至少一个汇编中将其归类为谚语时,将表达语视为谚语,但须遵守正文所描述的其他选择标准。

blocks.en: 4.2 Obtaining Proverb Topics
blocks.zh: 4.2 获得动词主题

blocks.en: As depicted in Figure 1 , we prompted Gemma-3-27B to generate up to three taxonomic tags for each proverb based on the proverb and its gist explanation. The system prompt instructed the model to act as “a proverb scholar, skilled in assigning accurate and concise taxonomic tags to proverbs, considering both their general meaning and specific illustrative context.” The user prompt presented the proverb and its gist and instructed the model to assign up to three tags of at most two words each, capturing the proverb’s general meaning as well as, where applicable, its specific illustrative imagery, to briefly reason through its choices before finalizing them, and to return only the tags in a fixed format, which permitted automatic extraction. The complete prompt is available in the project repository. Extracted tags were converted to lowercase and cleaned of surrounding whitespace.
blocks.zh: 如图1所描述的,我们促使Gemma-3-27B根据谚语及其要旨解释,为每句谚语产生最多三个分类标记。 系统促使该模型“作为一个谚语学者,考虑到谚语的一般含义和具体的说明背景,熟练地为谚语分配准确而简洁的分类标签。” 用户提示提供了谚语及其要旨,并指示该模型最多分配三个标记,每个标记最多两个字,抓住谚语的一般含义,并在适用的情况下,抓住其具体的说明性图像,在最后敲定之前通过自己的选择简单说明理由,并只以固定格式返回标记,从而允许自动取出。 项目存放处有完整的提示。 被提取的标记被转换为小写并清理了周围的白空间.

blocks.en: To consolidate variants of the same topic (e.g., singular and plural forms or close synonyms), we obtained a semantic vector representation (1,024 dimensions) for each unique tag using the Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B transformer ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , embedding each tag with the instruction “What is the meaning of this proverb category tag:”. We computed the angular similarity between all pairs of tags and grouped tags using complete-linkage hierarchical clustering, merging all pairs exceeding the top percentile of pairwise similarities. Each group of variants was represented by its most frequent tag, with a frequency equal to the summed frequencies of its members and a semantic vector equal to the average of its members’ vectors.
blocks.zh: 为了合并同一主题的变体(如单数和复数形式或近同义词),我们利用Qune3-Embedding-0.6B变体(张等,2025年),为每个独特的标记获得一个语义矢量表示(1,024维),将每个标记嵌入“这个谚语分类标记的含义:”的指令中。 我们用完全连接的分层组合计算了所有标记和分组标记之间的角相似性,将所有超过双相相似性上百分位数的标记合并起来。 每个变种组都以其最频繁的标记为代表,其频率等于其成员的总和频率,其语义矢量等于其成员矢量的平均值.

blocks.en: To create the topic map (Figure 2 A), we projected the consolidated tag vectors into a two-dimensional space using PaCMAP ( Wang et al., 2021 ) with angular distance. To color the map, we grouped the tags into 20 clusters by applying complete-linkage hierarchical clustering to the two-dimensional coordinates. The map displays the most frequent tags overall and within each cluster.
blocks.zh: 为了创建主题地图(图2 A),我们利用PaCMAP(Wang等,2021年)将被合并的标记向量投放到一个有角距离的二维空间. 为了给地图配色,我们通过对二维坐标应用全链接分层集群,将标记组合为20个集群. 地图显示的是总体和每个集群内最常见的标记.

blocks.en: 4.3 Rating Proverbs
blocks.zh: 4.3 评分副词

blocks.en: We used Gemma-3-27B (google/gemma-3-27b-it Gemma Team, 2025 ) to rate each proverb on its prescriptive capacity and on the nine key dimensions of human judgment and behavior. For each rating, the model received the proverb together with its gist explanation. The system prompt instructed the model to act as “an expert on proverbs and decision making who accurately assesses the meanings of proverbs.” The user prompt then posed one of the ten assessment questions listed below, prefixed by “Your task is to carry out the following assessment:” and followed by the instruction “To assess this, carefully examine both the proverb and its gist.” The prompt further instructed the model to briefly reason through the assessment before finalizing it and to return its answer as one of five response options in a fixed format, which permitted automatic extraction of the ratings. The complete prompts are available in the project repository. The ten assessment questions and their response options (in parentheses) were:
blocks.zh: 我们用了Gemma-3-27B(google/gemma-3-27b-it Gemma) 团队(Team, 2025)将评分每个谚语的规范能力和人类判断和行为的九个关键方面. 对于每个评分,该模型都得到了谚语以及其重点解释. 系统促使该模型担任“正确评估谚语含义的谚语和决策专家”。 然后,用户提示提出了以下10个评估问题之一,前缀是“你的任务是进行下列评估”并随后指示“评估这一点,仔细审查谚语及其要点”。 迅速行动还指示该模式在最后确定之前通过评估简单说明理由,并以固定格式将其答复作为五个答复选项之一,从而可以自动提取评级。 项目存放处有完整的提示。 十个评估问题及其答复选择(括号内)是:

blocks.en: “Does the proverb provide guidance on how to act or make decisions?” (‘strong no’, ‘no’, ‘indifferent’, ‘yes’, ‘strong yes’)
blocks.zh: " 谚语是否为如何采取行动或作出决定提供指导? " ( " 强烈不 " 、 " 不 " 、 " 无动于衷 " 、 " 是 " 、 " 强烈是 " )

blocks.en: “Does the proverb favor risk or caution?” (‘strongly favoring caution’, ‘favoring caution’, ‘indifferent’, ‘favoring risk’, ‘strongly favoring risk’)
blocks.zh: " 谚语是赞成风险还是谨慎? " (`强烈主张谨慎 ' 、`强烈主张谨慎 ' 、`无动于衷 ' 、`强烈主张风险 ' )

blocks.en: “Does the proverb favor short-term or long-term consequences?” (‘strongly favoring long-term consequences’, ‘favoring long-term consequences’, ‘indifferent’, ‘favoring short-term consequences’, ‘strongly favoring short-term consequences’)
blocks.zh: " 谚语是否有利于短期或长期后果? " ( " 强烈有利于长期后果 " 、 " 强烈有利于长期后果 " 、 " 无动于衷 " 、 " 强烈有利于短期后果 " )

blocks.en: “Does the proverb favor your own or other people’s interests?” (‘strongly favoring other people’s interests’, ‘favoring other people’s interests’, ‘indifferent’, ‘favoring your own interests’, ‘strongly favoring your own interests’)
blocks.zh: " 谚语是否有利于你自己或他人的利益? " ( " 强烈地有利于他人的利益 " , " 有利于他人的利益 " , " 无动于衷 " , " 有利于自己的利益 " , " 强烈地有利于自己的利益 " )

blocks.en: “Does the proverb favor autonomy or compliance?” (‘strongly favoring compliance’, ‘favoring compliance’, ‘indifferent’, ‘favoring autonomy’, ‘strongly favoring autonomy’)
blocks.zh: " 谚语是赞成自治还是遵守? " (`强烈赞成遵守 ' 、`赞成遵守 ' 、`无动于衷 ' 、`赞成自治 ' 、`强烈赞成自治 ' )

blocks.en: “Does the proverb favor trust or suspicion?” (‘strongly favoring trust’, ‘favoring trust’, ‘indifferent’, ‘favoring suspicion’, ‘strongly favoring suspicion’)
blocks.zh: " 谚语是否有利于信任或怀疑? " ( " 强烈支持信任 " 、 " 强烈支持信任 " 、 " 无动于衷 " 、 " 强烈支持怀疑 " )

blocks.en: “Does the proverb favor honesty or deception?” (‘strongly favoring honesty’, ‘favoring honesty’, ‘indifferent’, ‘favoring deception’, ‘strongly favoring deception’)
blocks.zh: " 谚语是否有利于诚实或欺骗? "

blocks.en: “Does the proverb favor equality or hierarchy?” (‘strongly favoring equality’, ‘favoring equality’, ‘indifferent’, ‘favoring hierarchy’, ‘strongly favoring hierarchy’)
blocks.zh: " 谚语是赞成平等还是等级? " ( " 强烈赞成平等 " 、 " 拥护平等 " 、 " 无动于衷 " 、 " 拥护等级 " 、 " 强烈赞成等级 " )

blocks.en: “Does the proverb favor kindness or malice?” (‘strongly favoring kindness’, ‘favoring kindness’, ‘indifferent’, ‘favoring malice’, ‘strongly favoring malice’)
blocks.zh: " 谚语是有利于仁爱还是恶意? " (`强烈地有利于仁爱',`仁爱',`无动于衷',`强烈地有利于")

blocks.en: “Does the proverb favor cooperation or competition?” (‘strongly favoring cooperation’, ‘favoring cooperation’, ‘indifferent’, ‘favoring competition’, ‘strongly favoring competition’)
blocks.zh: " 谚语是否有利于合作或竞争? " ( " 强烈支持合作 " 、 " 强烈支持合作 " 、 " 无动于衷 " 、 " 强烈支持竞争 " )

blocks.en: For analysis, responses were coded from 1 to 5 in the order listed above. Proverbs rated ‘yes’ or ‘strong yes’ on the prescriptivity question were classified as prescriptive. The analyses of the nine dimensions of judgment and behavior, including the extremity, polarity, and average recommendation results (Figure 4 ), are based on this subset of prescriptive proverbs, with LLM-based results restricted by the LLM’s classification and human-based results by the human raters’ classification. The validation analyses (Figure 2 B) are based on all rated proverbs.
blocks.zh: 为了进行分析,答复按上述顺序从1到5编码。 在规定性问题上,被评为 " 有 " 或 " 有 " 强 " 的动词被归类为指令性。 对判断和行为的九个方面,包括极端性、极性、和平均建议结果(图4)的分析基于这一指令性谚语的子集,而基于LLM的结果受到LLM的分类的限制,而基于人类的衡量结果则受到人类的分类的限制。 验证分析(图2 B)是基于所有被评为谚语的.

blocks.en: 4.4 Validation
blocks.zh: 4.4 审定

blocks.en: We compared the model’s ratings against those of two trained research assistants, who independently rated a random sample of 500 proverbs on all ten dimensions, using the same questions and response scales as the model. To probe whether our procedure of supplying the model-generated gist affects human judgment, the raters evaluated all proverbs twice, first in a block without the model-generated gist explanation and then in a block with it.
blocks.zh: 我们将该模型的评分与两位训练有素的研究助理的评分进行比较,他们独立地用与模型相同的问答尺度,对所有十个维度的500个谚语进行随机抽样评分。 为了探究我们提供模型生成的Gist的程序是否影响人类的判断,评分者对所有的谚语进行了两次评价,首先是在一个没有模型生成的Gist解释的区块中,然后用一个区块来评价.

blocks.en: We assessed alignment using Pearson correlations. At the level of individual proverbs, the model’s ratings correlated more strongly with the average human rating than the ratings of the two human raters correlated with each other, and this held for every dimension (see Figure 2 B). Providing the gist explanation increased alignment both between the human raters and between humans and the model, but the pattern of results was unchanged without it. Finally, we assessed alignment at the aggregate level by correlating, across the nine dimensions, the average ratings that determine our substantive conclusions. Aggregate alignment was high for both human-model (r = .74 with gist, .69 without) and human-human comparisons (r = .84 and .80). Human raters also corroborated the model’s classification of proverbs as prescriptive, judging 73.8% of proverbs as prescriptive compared with 67.1% according to the model. Except where results are reported separately by condition, all human results reported in this article are averages across the gist and no-gist conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们用皮尔逊的关联来评估校正 在个别谚语方面,模型的评级与人类平均评级的关系比两个人类评级者相互关联的评级更为密切,这一点对每个层面都适用(见图2 B)。 提供重点解释提高了人类评分数之间和人类与模型之间的校正度,但结果的规律没有改变. 最后,我们通过在九个方面将决定我们实质性结论的平均评级联系起来,评估了总体水平的一致。 人类模式(r=.74与gist, .69无)和人类与人类的比较(r=.84和.80)的总比值都很高。 人类评分法也证实了该模型将谚语归类为规范性谚语,根据该模型判断,73.8%的谚语为规范性谚语,而67.1%为规范性谚语。 除按条件单独报告结果外,本条所报出的所有人类结果均指跨吉他和无吉他条件的平均值.

blocks.en: 4.5 Code and data availability
blocks.zh: 4.5 守则和数据提供情况

blocks.en: The proverbs analyzed in this study comprise all proverbs listed in seven published dictionaries ( Mieder, 1992 ; Doyle et al., 2012 ; Mieder, 2021 ; Simpson and Speake, 2008 ; Knowles, 2016 ; Cordry, 2015 ; Stone, 2006 ) , compiled into a list of 49,528 unique proverbs. Because these works are protected by copyright, the compiled list cannot be shared publicly; it is available to editors and reviewers on request. The analysis code and the aggregated data underlying the figures are available at https://github.com/dwulff/proverb_prescriptions . The completed GUIDE-LLM reporting checklist ( Feuerriegel et al., 2026 ) is available in the same repository.
blocks.zh: 本研究所分析的谚语包括了7个已出版的词典(Mieder,1992年;Doyle等,2012年;Mieder,2021年;Simpson and Spee,2008年;Knowles,2016年;Cordry,2015年;Stone,2006年)所列举的所有谚语,被编为49,528个独特的谚语. 由于这些作品受版权保护,所编译的列表无法公开分享;编辑和审查人员可应要求查阅. 分析代码和数字的汇总数据见https://github.com/dwulff/proverb_prifers.。 已经完成的《准则》-LLM报告清单(Feuerriegel等人,2026年)可在同一资料库中查阅。
